newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hanjin Group targets '97 sales at 12 trln won.
newsitem.headline: Hanjin Group targets '97 sales at 12 trln won.

text.p: South Korea's Hanjin Group has set its sales target for 1997 at 12 trillion won against an estimated 10.2 trillion in 1996, a group spokesman said on Tuesday.
The group planned to spend two trillion won in total investment next year, unchanged from this year, spokesman Kim Sung-joon said.
"The majority of the investment will go to purchases of new planes, ships and facility equipment," Kim said.
Hanjin Group has 21 affiliate companies, including Korean Air Co Ltd.
